change_requests.title: Deploy the exhaustive batched DeepSeek advisory review gate
change_requests.notes: Closed on 2026-08-12. The final f3d7056 fixture correction and fea9492 diagnostic hardening were independently bootstrap-reviewed; the production CODE gate passed fea9492 with zero confirmed findings. The complete reviewer and remote-harness suites passed on windows-11-laptop and the five-platform hosted matrix (Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64, macOS ARM64/Intel). TEST_ARTIFACT and cross-document DOCUMENTATION reviews passed with zero confirmed findings. linux-x64-lxqt and windows-10-reference were unreachable during final retries at SSH transport, before execution; their earlier run reproduced the corrected fixture-only failure, while equivalent final Linux/Windows hosted suites passed. The deployed gate now binds active CR scope and exact requirement provenance to immutable evidence and protected receipts; uses candidate discovery, hostile falsification, independent severity confirmation, deterministic blocker synthesis, truthful artifact handling, bounded retries, private telemetry, and stale-receipt invalidation; and retains the independent bootstrap path.

change_requests.title: Repair review-gate latency without weakening evidence protections
acceptance_criteria: Pause feature development, including the preserved Z80 state candidate, until this repair is validated.
Normal one-unit clean review performs exactly one external discovery call.
Discovery uses deepseek-v4-pro with thinking disabled and no reasoning_effort field.
The combined discovery prompt covers requirements/functional correctness, runtime/safety/lifecycle/concurrency/recovery, and integration/regression/compatibility/test adequacy.
Falsification runs only for candidates that survive schema, requirement, scope, deterministic, context, and deduplication filtering.
Ordinary falsification uses thinking enabled with reasoning_effort high, not max.
Max reasoning is reserved for genuine evidence-backed adjudication.
A one-unit multi-file CODE packet does not automatically invoke a separate CODE-INTEGRATION call.
Dynamic review-unit sizing uses the actual stable prefix and fails closed when requirement scope is too broad.
Private active-review lock/status prevents duplicate live reviews of the same snapshot and recovers stale locks.
Overall review deadline fails closed instead of hanging or passing early.
Private telemetry records per-call phase, thinking mode, reasoning effort, token usage, elapsed time, retries, and final review-level counts.
Full changed-file immutable evidence, CR scope, requirement provenance, falsification, NON_BLOCKING, UNRESOLVED, HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED, secret exclusion, and receipt binding remain intact.
The retained legacy bootstrap gate is used as temporary authority for this repair before designated remote execution.
